title: Senior / Lead Salesforce Developer
description:
Senior / Lead Salesforce Developer

**Location:** Bangalore, Karnataka  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years  
**Job Type:** Full\-time

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Senior / Lead Salesforce Developer** with strong hands\-on expertise in Salesforce development, Apex, LWC, integrations, and Experience Cloud.

The ideal candidate should have **7\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce development experience** and at least **1–2 years of experience in a Senior/Lead Developer or technical mentoring role**.

You will be responsible for developing scalable Salesforce solutions, leading technical discussions, mentoring developers, and working on complex integrations and customer/partner portals.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead and mentor Salesforce developers and provide technical guidance.
* Design and develop complex Salesforce solutions using **Apex, Triggers, Classes, Controllers, and Flows**.
* Develop responsive and scalable user interfaces using **Lightning Web Components (LWC)**.
* Apply strong knowledge of **Salesforce Order of Execution, Governor Limits, bulkification, and transaction management**.
* Design and implement integrations between Salesforce and third\-party systems using **REST/SOAP APIs, Webhooks, and middleware such as MuleSoft/Boomi**.
* Develop and customize **Salesforce Experience Cloud / Communities / Partner Portals**.
* Implement appropriate Salesforce **security, sharing models, Sharing Sets, and access controls**.
* Build scalable solutions using **Batch Apex, Queueable Apex, Future methods, and Scheduled Apex**.
* Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, technical design, and troubleshooting.
* Collaborate with Solution Architects, Product Owners, QA teams, and other stakeholders.
* Follow Salesforce development best practices and maintain high\-quality, scalable code.
* Work with Git, SFDX, CI/CD pipelines, and sandbox environments.

Required Skills

**Mandatory:**

* 7\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce development experience
* 1–2\+ years of experience as a **Senior/Lead Developer or Technical Mentor**
* Strong **Apex** development experience
* Strong **Lightning Web Components (LWC)** experience
* Strong understanding of **Salesforce Order of Execution and Governor Limits**
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce **Integrations**
* Experience with **Experience Cloud / Communities**
* Hands\-on experience with **Asynchronous Apex**
* Strong understanding of Salesforce **Security and Sharing**

Technical Skills

* Apex, Triggers, Classes and Controllers
* Lightning Web Components (LWC)
* JavaScript, HTML, CSS
* Salesforce Flows and Automation
* REST / SOAP APIs
* OAuth 2\.0
* JSON / XML
* Platform Events
* Batch Apex
* Queueable Apex
* Future Methods
* Scheduled Apex
* Experience Builder
* Partner Portals / Customer Communities
* Git / SFDX
* CI/CD
* Copado / Jenkins / GitHub Actions
* Postman / SoapUI
* Large Data Volume (LDV) concepts

Preferred Certifications

* Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I
* Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II
* Salesforce Certified Experience Cloud Consultant
* Salesforce Certified Integration Architect
* Salesforce Certified JavaScript Developer I

Candidate Profile

Candidates should have strong hands\-on Salesforce development experience along with the ability to independently handle complex technical challenges and guide other developers.

**Please note:** Candidates who do not have strong experience in **Apex, LWC, Salesforce Order of Execution/Governor Limits, and Senior/Lead\-level responsibilities** may not be suitable for this position.

**Apply now** with your updated resume highlighting your Salesforce development and technical leadership experience.

Pay: Up to ₹2,000,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: ServiceNow Developer - ITOM
description:
**Job Summary:**



Fortive is seeking a skilled and motivated ServiceNow engineer with a strong focus on ITOM, CMDB/CSDM (Configuration Management Database/Common Service Data Model), Application Mapping, and Vulnerability Management. This role is central to supporting and advancing our global ServiceNow environment, with a particular emphasis on ensuring the integrity, completeness, and security of configuration data. Candidates will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing ServiceNow solutions that align with business requirements and best practices.



Candidates will work closely with architects, stakeholders, and external partners to enhance workflows, automate processes, and ensure platform supportability, performance, and upgradability. They will be responsible for development, documentation, test plans and the transition of developed solutions to our ServiceNow Operations team for business\-as\-usual support.



The ideal candidate should be a self\-starter ensuring CMDB data integrity and support core ITOM and related processes across the enterprise. They are able to work independently within a technical team and be comfortable operating in a fast\-paced organization. If you are passionate about transforming IT services and thrive in a dynamic, global setting, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity!


**Primary Responsibilities and Job Duties:**


* Drive adoption and continuous improvement of ITOM, CMDB and CSDM, applying robust controls to ensure configuration data quality and accuracy across multiple sources.


* Design and implement ServiceNow Application Mapping to visualize and manage relationships between infrastructure components and business applications.


* Implement integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise applications, especially those that enhance ITOM, CMDB, and Vulnerability Management capabilities.


* Define and enforce CMDB governance \& data quality standards


* Deep understanding of ServiceNow MID\-server architecture and the role it plays in Discovery optimization, discovery patterns, Discovery schedules and cloud discovery.


* Perform data audits, health checks, and reconciliation.


* Collaborate with stakeholders in ITSM, ITOM, Asset \& Vulnerability to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions for process alignment.


* Work across other ServiceNow modules and capabilities according to demand.


* Design and develop solutions on the ServiceNow platform.


* Ensure compliance with ServiceNow development standards, low\-code/no\-code, configuration\-not\-customization and other best practices.


* Maintain a high standard of code quality by writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code optimizing for performance


* Act as Tier 3 escalation point for the ServiceNow Operations team to assist with resolution of issues with ServiceNow applications or integrations.


* Stay updated with the latest ServiceNow features and enhancements and recommend improvements.


* Communicate technical problems and solutions to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


* Participate in process design workshops and kaizen events.


* Occasional travel both nationally and internationally.


* Other Duties as assigned or required.


**Qualifications**



Required:


* 3\+ years of experience in ServiceNow development and administration, with proven expertise in ITOM, CMDB, Application Mapping, and Vulnerability Management.


* Deep understanding of ServiceNow MID\-server architecture and the role it plays in Discovery optimization, discovery patterns, Discovery schedules, Cloud discovery, Event Management


* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure—including servers, networks, storage, virtualization, and cloud services—is essential for accurately modeling configuration items and their relationships within a CMDB.


* Track record of driving CMDB and CSDM adoption, preferably with evidence of applying controls around configuration data quality across multiple sources


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.


* Proven bias for low\-code/no\-code approaches to development.


* Proficiency in JavaScript, Glide API, and ServiceNow scripting.


* Experience integrating ServiceNow with other enterprise systems.


* Familiarity with the Agile methodology and working with Stories and Sprints to deliver new capabilities.


* Excellent problem\-solving and communication skills.


* Ability to lead small projects with manageable risks.


* Comfortable working in a lean, fast\-paced technology environment with high expectations.


* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while delivering results.


* Acts as a mentor and resource for other colleagues.



Preferred:


* Experience with Service Portal/Employee Center, Flow Designer, Integration Hub, NowAssist, Virtual Agent, AI Search, Performance Analytics, Platform Analytics, Event Management, Health Log Analytics, dashboards and reporting.


* Familiarity with Solarwinds, DataDog or similar observability tools.


* Evidence of commitment to continuous learning via certifications or attendance at conferences.

title: Staff Software Development Engineer
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160\+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE\-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in\-line cloud security platform.



We believe the future of work is Human \+ AI and are building an AI\-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.


**Role**



We are looking for a Staff Software Development Engineer to join our team. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, reporting to the Director, of Engineering.


**What you'll do (Role Expectations)**


* Lead ZCC feature design and hands\-on C\+\+ implementation on Linux environment.
* Take full technical ownership of complex projects, from concept to deployment.
* Elevate code quality and enforce best practices to ensure a robust, efficient, and secure client.
* Ability to process packets at both ingress and egress points at very high speed so that client using the system does not perceive any increased latencies.
* To work cross\-functionally with the Quality Assurance team to test the work product, and influence the testing to make the product ready for deployment


**Who You Are (Success Profile)**


* You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
* You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high\-level strategy and hands\-on execution.
* You are a problem\-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser\-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
* You are a high\-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
* You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.


**What We're Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)**


* Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI\-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
* 5\+ years of experience of developing enterprise applications with distributed systems background.
* Strong C/C\+\+ programming, Data structures/Algorithms \& debugging skills in a cloud environment.
* Deep understanding of Operating System principles and OS like Linux/Unix.
* Extensive network programming experience (TCP/IP, HTTP/S, DNS, proxy) with knowledge of kernel\-mode networking or NDIS drivers


**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**


* Experience implementing AIOps, AI\-driven predictive scaling, or automated anomaly detection to optimize cloud infrastructure performance and reliability
* Understanding of cybersecurity principles, encryption (PKI, TLS/SSL), authentication, endpoint agents, and anti\-tampering
* Experience in Network Data Path \& Socket programming \& POSIX Multi\-thread programming.

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. Collins Aerospace, an RTX business, is a global leader in aerospace and defense technologies. We develop advanced solutions across commercial aviation, business aviation, military, and space markets.


Our teams work on technologies that support aircraft from design and manufacturing through operation and maintenance. At Collins Aerospace, you will work with talented professionals on complex global programs while contributing to solutions that improve safety, reliability, performance, and customer experience.

 **Job Overview**


Collins Aerospace is looking for an experienced **Software Engineer** to join our team and play a key role in advancing aerospace simulation technologies through the **DESYRE co\-simulation environment and framework**.


In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, enhancing, and maintaining DESYRE software components while ensuring the platform delivers **high performance, stability, accuracy, and reliability**. You will work on challenging problems involving **modeling, simulation, hybrid systems, and co\-simulation**, applying advanced concepts such as Models of Computation and Execution Semantics.

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including systems and software engineering, model\-based design, and test engineering, to deliver end\-to\-end solutions.

 **What You Will Learn**


In this role, you will have the opportunity to expand your expertise while working on advanced aerospace simulation and digital engineering technologies.

* Gain deep exposure to **DESYRE**, a custom aerospace co\-simulation application and framework.
* Strengthen your expertise in **modeling, simulation, hybrid systems, and co\-simulation**.
* Work with advanced **Models of Computation and Execution Semantics**, including synchronous, discrete\-event, continuous\-time, and hybrid systems.
* Gain hands\-on experience with industry standards such as **FMI, TLM, HLA, ED247, and DPC**.

* Enhance your skills in **Python, C\+\+, SystemC**, and distributed/real\-time simulation architectures.
* Learn and apply advanced **software architecture, design patterns, system integration, and engineering best practices**.
* Gain exposure to **MBSE, digital engineering, DevSecOps, and model\-based design environments**.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional engineering teams and develop strong experience in delivering **end\-to\-end aerospace simulation solutions**.
* Develop your technical leadership skills by **mentoring engineers, driving engineering excellence, and contributing to architectural decisions**.
* Work on challenging engineering problems where **software, systems engineering, modeling, and simulation come together** to support next\-generation aerospace technologies.

* Experience with principles in the domain of modelling (model management, model transformation, etc) and simulation (multi\-formalism, hybrid simulation, co\-simulation, etc.)
* Knowledge of model\-based theory (abstract interpretation, static and dynamic analysis), practice (experience with modeling and simulation environments, solvers, etc.), and a good knowledge of mathematical formalization, discrete and continuous dynamics modeling
* Expert\-level knowledge of Models of Computation and Execution Semantics (synchronous, discrete\-event, continuous\-time, hybrid).

Solid understanding of Linux, Arm architectures, open\-source software development, versioning, licensing, SDL, and software delivery, complemented by strong system\-level debugging and root\-cause analysis skills.
* Good experience in architecting and maintaining scalable CI/CD infrastructure for large, multi\-component repository structures, build systems, dependency management, variant management, automated testing, packaging, and release automation.
* Proven experience enabling continuous software delivery, with a strong focus on pipeline availability, stability, automation, observability, rapid failure recovery, and release readiness!
* Strong end\-to\-end technical leadership and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence across teams and drive continuous improvement.

**Desirable Skills \& Qualities**

title: Sr Engineer - Cloud Enablement
description:
**About Us:**  



  

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy and that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from diverse backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world\-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.

 **Target Tech Overview:**


Every time a guest enters a Target store or browses Target.com, they experience the impact of Target’s investments in technology and innovation. We’re the technologists behind one of the most loved retail brands, delivering joy to millions of our guests, team members, and communities.

  

Our global in\-house technology team of more than 5,000 of engineers, data scientists, architects, coaches and product managers strive to make Target the most convenient, safe and joyful place to shop. We use agile practices and leverage open\-source software to adapt and build best\-in\-class technology for our team members and guests—and we do so with a focus on diversity and inclusion, experimentation and continuous learning.

 **Pyramid Overview:**


The Cloud Enablement team builds and operates the foundational public cloud platform that engineering teams across Target rely on to deliver at enterprise scale. Working primarily on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), the team owns a hardened, standardized cloud foundation spanning compute, Kubernetes, storage, networking, and identity — the core building blocks that power Target's digital and data\-driven experiences. Our mission is to make cloud simple, secure, and cost\-effective to consume: we design the opinionated patterns, policies, and guardrails that keep workloads safe and reliable, and we build the APIs, automation, and self\-service tooling that let teams adopt and scale cloud services with confidence. Following an infrastructure\-as\-code philosophy, we treat repeatability, resilience, and security as first\-class engineering outcomes rather than afterthoughts. We partner closely with platform and product teams to onboard new workloads, drive cloud cost stewardship, and continuously raise the bar on operational excellence, availability, and readiness for our highest\-traffic events. As a lead engineer on this team, you'll help shape cloud strategy, architect platform capabilities and tooling, and set technical direction that multiplies the productivity of engineers across the company — a high\-impact role at the center of how Target builds in the cloud.

  

As a Senior Engineer on the Cloud Enablement team, you'll contribute:

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Design, build, deploy, and support scalable cloud platform capabilities using cloud services, preferably **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**, with a strong focus on reliability, security, automation, and developer experience in **Golang.**
* Implement cloud engineering best practices across resource provisioning, configuration management, monitoring, observability, security, governance, and cost optimization.
* Develop and maintain cloud infrastructure and platform services using **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** technologies to automate infrastructure deployment and configuration.
* Build and maintain APIs, automation services, and operational tooling that simplify cloud operations and improve engineering productivity.
* Drive continuous improvement by adopting and advancing automation, orchestration, **GitOps, self\-service tooling, and reusable platform patterns**.
* Apply your technical expertise and stay current with emerging technologies and practices across cloud computing, Kubernetes, platform engineering, and DevOps.
* Evaluate new technologies and contribute to technical decision\-making. Initiate and execute research and proof\-of\-concept activities to assess new technologies and approaches.
* Provide technical guidance for both routine and complex engineering challenges, including troubleshooting issues across cloud infrastructure, networking, IAM, CI/CD, observability, monitoring, logging, and tracing. Escalate issues when appropriate.
* Participate in complex design, construction, automation, migration, and implementation initiatives, ensuring solutions meet architectural, security, compliance, and operational requirements.
* Establish and evolve engineering standards and best practices for monitoring, testing, automation, security, and maintenance of cloud platform components, infrastructure services, and shared engineering capabilities.
* Maintain a strong understanding of the organization’s technical capabilities, cloud infrastructure, platform services, and broader technology environment.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Four\-year degree or equivalent practical experience.
* **6\+ years of experience** in software development **(Golang),** cloud engineering **(Google Cloud),** platform engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or infrastructure engineering, with a focus on cloud services.
* Strong domain knowledge of cloud platforms, including **account/project management, compute, storage, databases, networking, serverless technologies, IAM, security, observability, and cost management**.
* Hands\-on experience with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as **Terraform, Pulumi, Crossplane**, or similar tools.
* Experience developing **APIs, automation, and operational tooling** using **Golang, Python, and Bash scripting**.
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies including **Docker, Kubernetes**, and managed Kubernetes platforms such as **Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)**.
* Experience with observability, monitoring, logging, and tracing technologies such as **OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, Google Cloud Operations, Splunk, Datadog**, or similar platforms.

* Use Git from the command line daily — branching, merging, resolving conflicts, and managing GitHub pull requests and/or Gerrit changes.
* Apply AI tools and agent\-based workflows to accelerate scripting, debugging, and documentation.

* Experience with GitHub and or Gerrit workflows.
* Experience with Jenkins and or GitHub Actions — reading logs, re\-running jobs, and diagnosing pipeline failures.
* Solid knowledge of localization workflows and file formats (XML, JSON, CSV, YAML).
* Experience debugging encoding, layout, file\-conversion, or resource\-integration issues.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted engineering — awareness of agent workflows, coding assistants, and MCP tooling, and the judgment to use them effectively.
* Solid problem\-solving skills and the ability to work across multiple teams and systems.

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with iOS/Android build processes and common mobile UI behaviors.
* Experience with PC software or game development.
* Experience mentoring or leading a small engineering team (for senior candidates).

### **Tech Stack \& Environment**

* Languages / Scripting: Python, Shell / Bash, PowerShell.
* Version Control: Git (command\-line first), GitHub, Gerrit.
* CI/CD: Jenkins, GitHub Actions.
* Formats: XML, JSON, CSV, YAML.
* Platforms / Environments: Windows/PC pipelines, Android, iOS, Ubuntu.
* AI Tooling: AI coding assistants, agent workflows, MCP\-based tooling.

description:

**About the role**
------------------

The Software Engineer Professional is a hands‑on software engineer who delivers high‑quality software as part of a small, outcome‑focused pod of typically 4–5 engineers. The role operates in an AI‑native delivery model, where AI tools and agents are used across the software development lifecycle (SDLC) to accelerate delivery, improve quality, and reduce manual effort.

  

Unlike traditional engineering roles, the Pod Engineer is expected to work with AI as a core delivery partner, using AI tools for requirements understanding, design exploration, code generation, testing, documentation, and optimisation—while remaining accountable for correctness, security, and production readiness.


**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

**1\) Hands‑On Software Delivery**

* Design, build, test, and deploy software components as part of a delivery pod.
* Contribute production‑quality code across backend, frontend, APIs, or integration layers, depending on the pod’s scope.
* Own features end‑to‑end—from understanding requirements through to deployment and support.
  

**2\) AI‑Enabled SDLC Execution**

* Use AI tools and assistants across delivery stages to:
* Accelerate understanding of requirements and acceptance criteria
* Generate and refine code safely
* Create and maintain automated tests
* Support documentation and release artefacts
* Apply judgment to validate AI‑generated outputs, ensuring correctness, maintainability, and security.
* Continuously improve personal and pod‑level productivity through effective AI usage.
  

**3\) Engineering Quality \& Standards**

* Write clean, maintainable, well‑tested code aligned to agreed engineering standards.
* Participate actively in code reviews, pair programming, and design discussions.
* Follow secure coding practices and ensure solutions meet performance, reliability, and resilience expectations.
  

**4\) Pod Collaboration**

* Work closely with the Pod Lead Engineer and other Pod Engineers to deliver outcomes as a cohesive unit.
* Contribute to daily planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Support knowledge sharing, experimentation, and continuous improvement within the pod.
  

**5\) Learning \& Capability Development**

* Continuously develop skills in modern software engineering and AI‑assisted development techniques.
* Adopt and share good practices for prompt design, AI evaluation, and safe AI usage.
* Stay current with emerging tools, frameworks, and patterns relevant to AI‑enabled engineering.
  

**6\) Governance, Risk \& Responsible Engineering**

* Adhere to security, data protection, and governance requirements.
* Flag risks, defects, or concerns early—especially those introduced by AI‑assisted development.
* Ensure delivery artefacts are complete, auditable, and fit for production use.
* What Makes This Role Different from a Traditional Software Engineer
* You work in small, high‑impact pods, not large project teams.
* AI is used by default across the SDLC, not occasionally.
* Success is measured by outcomes, quality, and speed, not just code output.
* You are expected to think critically about AI outputs, not blindly accept them.
**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Strong experience as a software engineer delivering production systems.
* Solid foundations in software engineering fundamentals: data structures, APIs, testing, CI/CD, and debugging.
* Proven expertise in Java, Python along with UI and backend technologies like React, PostgreSQL, Neptune DB.
* Strong credentials in Cloud environments like AWS.
* Experience working in Agile / iterative delivery environments.
* Practical exposure to AI‑assisted development tools (e.g. Copilot, Amazon Kiro, Claude Code, automated testing, AI‑supported documentation).
* Possess B. Tech or B.E. degree in Computer Science or related field.
**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Experience working in small squads or pods with shared ownership of outcomes.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms and modern delivery pipelines.
* Curiosity and enthusiasm for using AI to improve how software is built.
  

**Success Measures (What Good Looks Like)**

* High‑quality features delivered on time as part of a dev team.
* Effective and responsible use of AI to improve productivity and quality.
* Clean, well‑tested, and maintainable code in production.
* Positive contribution to pod collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.
* Growing proficiency in AI‑native engineering practices.

This role reports to the Engineering Director.

description:

We are seeking a **Senior Software Engineer II** to join our **Audit Logging \& Security Visibility** team. This team builds the systems that record and surface security\-relevant activity across DigitalOcean's cloud platform, so customers and internal teams can detect threats, investigate incidents, and prove compliance — at billions of events a day.



In this role, you will set the technical direction for Audit Logging at DigitalOcean — defining how our event pipelines, SIEM integrations, and security visibility platform evolve over multi\-year horizons, and how they intersect with IAM, threat detection, and platform needs. You will be a primary technical voice in cross\-org decisions, and you will set the engineering standards the team builds against. If you are a seasoned engineer who wants to combine deep technical expertise with broad organizational impact, this is the role for you.


**What you'll do**
------------------


* **Define Platform Architecture:** Set the multi\-year technical strategy for audit logging, SIEM integration, and security visibility — designing for hyperscale event volumes and the evolving needs of enterprise customers.
* **Architect for Cross\-Domain Integration:** Lead decisions on how audit and telemetry systems intersect with IAM, threat detection, and platform engineering, so signals stay consistent across all of them.
* **Own Security Visibility Strategy:** Define the long\-term architecture for the Unified Security Dashboard and SIEM integrations (Splunk, Datadog, Chronicle, Sentinel) — setting patterns other teams build on, not just shipping one integration at a time.
* **Set Sustaining Engineering Standards:** Define what logging schema standards, event taxonomy, and operational hygiene look like across the domain, and hold the team accountable to that bar.
* **Architect for True Scale:** Design systems and data models that handle billions of events per day across multiple regions, with guaranteed delivery — anticipating multi\-year growth, not just current load.
* **Shape Cross\-Org Technical Decisions:** Be a key technical voice in design reviews spanning Audit Logging, IAM, Threat Detection, and Platform Engineering. Resolve architectural conflicts early, before they become production incidents.
* **Mentor Senior Engineers:** Coach engineers on system design, security engineering, and technical communication; act as a multiplier for the team's overall capability.
* **Translate Strategy to Leadership:** Communicate audit platform strategy and investment rationale to senior leadership, framing decisions in terms of customer trust, compliance risk, and business impact.

**What You'll Add to DigitalOcean**
-----------------------------------


* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 8\+ years of software engineering experience, with real depth in audit logging, security telemetry, SIEM integration, or high\-throughput data pipelines — ideally at cloud or enterprise scale.
* **Language Expert:** Expert\-level **Go**, with strong judgment on gRPC\-based service design that other engineers will build against.
* **Systems Mastery:** Proven ability to design and run high\-throughput streaming systems (Kafka, Flink) at scale, with guaranteed delivery, ordering, and multi\-region resilience.
* **Security Observability:** A track record of building security visibility platforms — dashboards, control planes, or SIEM integrations across cloud environments.
* **Compliance \& Distributed Systems:** Solid understanding of audit requirements for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and similar frameworks; deep expertise in distributed systems that other teams depend on.
* **Cloud Native:** Hands\-on expertise with Kubernetes, Terraform, SQL, and analytical/columnar data stores at platform scale.
* **Communication:** Able to drive technical consensus across org boundaries and translate platform strategy into business impact for leadership.

**Nice to Have**
----------------


* Experience with OpenTelemetry, OCSF, or other security telemetry standards.
* Familiarity with threat detection platforms or UEBA systems.
* Experience supporting compliance frameworks (SOC 2, FedRAMP, PCI\-DSS) as they intersect with audit and access controls.
* Contributions to open\-source security, observability, or data pipeline projects.


* This job is located in Bengaluru, India



JR: 2026\-7972

**Why You'll Like Working for DigitalOcean**
--------------------------------------------

description:
**Bring more to life.**


Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?


At Cepheid, one of Danaher’s 15\+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.


You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Our mission drives us to develop groundbreaking solutions for the world’s most complex health challenges. Together, we bring MORE change to the world.

The **Principal Manufacturing Software Engineer** is responsible for Leading development of manufacturing software platforms for diagnostic instruments, including testing, calibration, firmware flashing, and validation. Build C\#/C\+\+ applications that interface with hardware, manage compliant production data ((electronic Device History Record), and enable AI\-driven quality and process optimization. Collaborate across R\&D, Manufacturing, and Quality functions in a regulated medical device environment.


This position reports to the **Principal Software/Firmware Engineer** and is part of the Software/Firmware Engineering job family located in Bangalore, India and will be an on\-site role.


**In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**

* Architect, design, and lead the development of a scalable and robust software platform for instrument manufacturing. This includes software for production line testing, component calibration, firmware flashing, and support SQA to do manufacturing software verification.
* Develop sophisticated software applications (primarily in C\#/C\+\+) that interface directly with our diagnostic instruments and test fixtures to automate complex test sequences and calibration procedures.
* Design and implement the systems for collecting, storing, and retrieving all manufacturing data for each instrument's electronic Device History Record (eDHR). Ensure all data is secure and compliant with regulatory requirements.
* Work intimately with R\&D hardware and firmware engineers to understand instrument test requirements, with Manufacturing Engineers to optimize production workflows, and with Quality Assurance to ensure software validation.
* Utilize past manufacturing data to develop AI tools to predict the modules/instruments failure and optimize the calibration process

* Proven experience designing software that interfaces with and controls physical hardware and test equipment.
* Strong experience with database design (SQL) and data management for production environments and strong experience in Cloud program development, AWS Lambda APIs.
* Experience working in a regulated industry such as diagnostic/ medical devices, aerospace, or automotive.

**Travel, Motor Vehicle Record \& Physical/Environment Requirements:**

* Ability to travel as required and collaborate with global internal and external stakeholders.

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

* Direct experience developing software under a diagnostic/ medical device quality management system (ISO 13485\)
* Familiarity with the requirements for software validation in an FDA\-regulated environment

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.


Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.**Job Summary**


As a Senior Software Engineer – Java Full Stack, you will be expected to work as a self\-driven, hands\-on individual contributor with strong ownership of end\-to\-end design, development, validation, and delivery of product features across both backend and frontend layers. You should bring 4–6 years of experience in Java\-based backend services, REST APIs, microservices, cloud\-native deployments, and modern frontend development using frameworks such as React or Angular. While this is primarily an individual contributor role, mentoring remains an important expectation: you should support junior engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, implementation support, and knowledge sharing. The role also requires ensuring secure and high\-quality delivery, supporting customer escalations, and driving innovation through PoCs and continuous improvements.

**Job Requirement and Responsibilities**

* The Senior Software Engineer – Java Full Stack will be responsible for independently owning product feature development across backend and frontend layers, including design, implementation, validation, and delivery of scalable software applications and systems.
* The candidate should be hands\-on, self\-driven, and technically strong enough to contribute independently while continuing to mentor engineers, review code, and guide implementation decisions where required.
* The role requires strong individual ownership, proactive problem solving, and the ability to drive assigned work to closure with minimal supervision while collaborating effectively with product, QA, DevOps, and architecture stakeholders.
* Mandatory experience is required in both backend engineering using Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, databases, and cloud\-native patterns, as well as frontend engineering using React or Angular, TypeScript/JavaScript, UI integration, and responsive web application development.
* You need to follow development processes and security processes, and will ensure the technical quality of the solution with UTs coverage and handle/identify security vulnerabilities.
* You will work on Customers escalated issues.
* You will get exposure to working on cutting\-edge technologies and innovation events.
* Drive innovation by proposing, prototyping, and evaluating new technical solutions (PoCs), and contribute to continuous improvements in performance, scalability, and developer productivity.
* Contribute innovative ideas for technical improvements and processes.
* Technologies should not be a constraint for the right person; however, strong hands\-on exposure to Java full stack development is mandatory. The role involves Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, React or Angular, TypeScript/JavaScript, Kubernetes, and ownership of deployments and chart definitions for our applications.

**Job Knowledge, Skill and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics and Communication, or a related discipline, with 4–6 years of application development experience, including strong hands\-on Java full stack development across backend and frontend technologies.
* Strong hands\-on experience in designing and implementing REST API based backend applications using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot frameworks.
* Strong exposure to frontend technologies such as React or Angular is mandatory, with the ability to collaborate on UI architecture, review frontend implementation, and ensure seamless integration with backend services.
* Core knowledge in Data Structures, OOPS, Solid design principles, and common Design Patterns is must.
* Working exposure to any cloud stack (GCP, AWS) is must.
* Leveraging AI in routine work or personal POCs will be an added advantage.
* Exposure to Cloud and Kubernetes\-based applications will be an important factor.
* The ideal candidate should be technology\-agnostic, adaptable, and comfortable learning and working across different languages, frameworks, and platforms as required.
* Hands\-on experience with a modern cloud\-friendly programming language such as Python or Node.js. will be an added advantage.
* Experience in Unit Testing and any automation (BDD) framework will be nice to have.
* Good exposure to any relational database MSSQL or MySql.
* Exposure in Micro Services architecture and Docker based application will be an added advantage.

**What do we offer?**


At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!


At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

This team is responsible for building the scalable backend infrastructure, control planes, and hypervisor\-orchestration engines that provision, lifecycle\-manage, and scale compute workloads safely and reliably.



In this role, you will help design and develop high\-throughput backend systems that orchestrate complex VM placement and execution workflows, interface with hypervisor control layers, and process real\-time resource\-telemetry signals. You will work on solving distributed systems problems at the intersection of host infrastructure orchestration, hypervisor management, and asynchronous control flows, ensuring our core compute platforms are robust, scalable, and highly available.


**What you'll do**
------------------


* Designing, building, and maintaining robust backend services and highly concurrent asynchronous workflows for virtual machine provisioning, placement, and lifecycle management, primarily in Python and Go.
* Integrating backend control planes with hypervisor and host virtualization layers (e.g., KVM, QEMU) to safely manage compute resources, block storage attachments, and virtual networking context.
* Building and operating scalable APIs (gRPC, REST) to serve as the connective tissue across compute orchestration engines, host metadata services, and internal infrastructure platforms.
* Collaborating closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure host infrastructure reliably supports high\-density hyperthreading, autoscale policies, and customer SLA guarantees.
* Driving engineering best practices, including code reviews, comprehensive testing, and technical design documentation.
* Monitoring core system performance, investigating control\-plane bottlenecks, and ensuring high reliability of compute orchestration systems.

**What You'll Add to DigitalOcean**
-----------------------------------


* 5\+ years of software engineering experience building highly concurrent, fault\-tolerant distributed systems.Deep proficiency in Python and Go (or strong experience in C\+\+/Java with a willingness to master Python and Go quickly).
* Hands\-on experience with durable workflow orchestration engines for managing distributed state, hardware scheduling, and long\-running asynchronous tasks.
* Strong working knowledge of virtualization, hypervisors, containerization, or low\-level system isolation technologies (e.g., KVM, QEMU, libvirt, Docker, or microVMs).
* Experience building resilient APIs and handling high\-throughput telemetry, control\-plane signals, or message streams.
* A strong sense of ownership, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work effectively in a globally distributed team.
* Cloud Infrastructure Awareness: While you do not need to be a kernel developer, you possess a strong foundational understanding of host resource scheduling, storage/network virtualization trade\-offs, and the unique architectural challenges of building multi\-tenant infrastructure.


* This job is located in Bengaluru, India



JR: 2026\-7635


*\#LI\-Hybrid*

**Why You'll Like Working for DigitalOcean**
--------------------------------------------


* **We innovate with purpose.** You'll be a part of a cutting\-edge technology company with an upward trajectory, who are proud to simplify cloud and AI so builders can spend more time creating software that changes the world. As a member of the team, you will be a Shark who thinks big, bold, and scrappy, like an owner with a bias for action and a powerful sense of responsibility for customers, products, employees, and decisions.
* **We prioritize career development.** At DO, you'll do the best work of your career. You will work with some of the smartest and most interesting people in the industry. We are a high\-performance organization that will always challenge you to think big. Our organizational development team will provide you with resources to ensure you keep growing. We provide employees with reimbursement for relevant conferences, training, and education. All employees have access to LinkedIn Learning's 10,000\+ courses to support their continued growth and development.
* **We care about your well\-being.** Regardless of your location, we will provide you with a competitive array of benefits to support you from our Employee Assistance Program to Local Employee Meetups to flexible time off policy, to name a few. While the philosophy around our benefits is the same worldwide, specific benefits may vary based on local regulations and preferences.
* **We reward our employees.** The salary range for this position is based on market data, relevant years of experience, and skills. You may qualify for a bonus in addition to base salary; bonus amounts are determined based on company and individual performance. We also provide equity compensation to eligible employees, including equity grants upon hire and the option to participate in our Employee Stock Purchase Program.
* **DigitalOcean is an equal\-opportunity employer.** We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.


**Application Limit:** You may apply to a maximum of 3 positions within any 180\-day period. This policy promotes better role\-candidate matching and encourages thoughtful applications where your qualifications align most strongly.

title: Sr. Software Engineer (Integrations)
description:
**About Dialpad**  

Dialpad is the AI platform for customer experience, built to resolve customer problems in real time across voice and digital. Our AI agents learn from your best human agents and improve with every interaction, helping organizations understand their customers, deliver better experiences, increase operational efficiencies, and build a lasting competitive advantage.



Unlike legacy systems built to route and answer, or standalone agentic bot vendors built to deflect, Dialpad was built to resolve. Our AI agents and human agents operate on a single platform with shared context, allowing Agentic AI to resolve issues, advance deals, and eliminate busywork through automation while seamlessly handing conversations to humans when needed, with full context preserved.



Market\-leading brands, including Randstad, Motorola Solutions, Netflix, the San Diego Padres, the Colorado Rockies Baseball Club, and Cal Athletics, trust Dialpad. Dialpad is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, GV, ICONIQ Capital, and T\-Mobile.


**Being a Dialer**  

At Dialpad, AI isn't just a feature; it's how our teams do their best work every day. We put powerful AI tools in every employee's hands so they can move faster, think bigger, and achieve more.



We believe every conversation matters. And we've built the platform that turns those conversations into insight and action, for our customers and ourselves.



We look for people who are intensely curious and hold themselves to a high bar. Our ambition is significant, and achieving it requires a team that operates at the highest level. We seek individuals who embody our core traits: **Scrappy, Curious, Optimistic, Persistent, and Empathetic**.

**Your role**  

As a Sr. Software Engineer on the Integrations team, you will lead the design and development of Dialpad's key native integrations. These integrations enable real\-time automation and data transfer between Dialpad and complementary systems, ensuring our mutual customers have a seamless, unified experience. This includes Agentic AI\-compatible integrations, CRMs, ticketing systems, workforce management platforms, and industry\-specific verticals such as recruiting, retail, and healthcare.



You will own a functional area or set of related features within Integrations, translating customer and business needs into robust technical solutions. You will help shape the 6\-12 month technical direction for your area, break down larger projects into clear deliverables, and solve classes of problems through shared tools, patterns, and processes.



You'll collaborate closely with engineering teammates, product leaders, business leaders, Dialpad customers, and external stakeholders. You will be expected to operate with little guidance, make pragmatic business and technical tradeoffs, and mentor other engineers through design, implementation, code review, debugging, and production support.



This position reports to our Engineering Manager and has the opportunity to be based in our Bangalore office. The position will require a hybrid working arrangement based out of our Bangalore office.


**What you'll do**


* Own the technical design, development, maintenance, and reliability of key native integrations across Dialpad's Integrations platform.
* Build and enhance integrations with systems such as Zendesk, HubSpot, AthenaHealth, Salesforce, Microsoft Teams, Google Workspace, and other customer\-critical SaaS platforms.
* Lead the delivery of Agentic AI\-compatible integrations that help customers automate workflows and connect Dialpad actions with external systems.
* Write architectural design and specification documents that clearly describe implementation options, tradeoffs, dependencies, risks, rollout plans, and success metrics.
* Develop backend services, APIs, workers, webhooks, data transfer flows, UI components, and automation workflows that scale across a large customer base.
* Break down larger projects into smaller deliverables and take responsibility for execution, delivery milestones, and the end\-to\-end result.
* Develop well\-tested features with appropriate test hooks, monitoring, and alerting, resulting in low defect reports and healthier customer scenarios.
* Design for performance, reliability, debuggability, extensibility, security, privacy, and operational simplicity.
* Debug complex production issues across Dialpad services and third\-party platforms, then turn those learnings into durable fixes and better team processes.
* Write clean, modular, and maintainable code using best practices along with unit tests.
* Participate in code and design reviews to ensure quality, maintainability, and scalability.
* Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior engineers.
* Assist with emerging Agentic AI technologies and initiatives.
* Tech Stack: Python, Vue.js, Redis, Google Cloud, AI (MCP).


**Skills you'll bring**


* 7\+ years of professional experience as a software engineer, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience owning significant backend, full\-stack, platform, or integration systems in production, including design, implementation, launch, monitoring, and maintenance.
* Experience with at least one object\-oriented programming language, especially Python or JavaScript.
* Experience building integrations, APIs, webhooks, event\-driven systems, distributed systems, or customer\-facing platform features.
* Strong testing, debugging, and troubleshooting skills, especially across distributed systems and third\-party platform boundaries.
* Experience with OAuth, permission models, API rate limits, webhooks, event delivery, retries, idempotency, and third\-party platform constraints.
* Experience with Agile development methodologies.
* Effective communication skills, including writing design documents, surfacing risks early, and keeping stakeholders aligned.
* Collaborative team player who can work independently and autonomously when needed.
* Ability to evaluate multiple technical approaches and explain tradeoffs clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Pragmatic approach to solving problems while balancing customer impact, engineering quality, delivery timelines, and business goals.
* Experience mentoring engineers and raising the quality bar for a team.
* Agentic AI experience or strong interest in building AI\-compatible product workflows.
* Usage of AI coding assistants such as Claude, Gemini, or similar tools for the majority of coding tasks.

**Why Join Dialpad**


* Work at the center of the AI transformation in business communications
* Build and ship agentic AI products that are redefining how companies operate
* Join a team where AI amplifies every employee's impact
* Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and real opportunities for growth


We believe in investing in our people. Dialpad offers competitive benefits and perks, cutting\-edge AI tools, and a robust training program that help you reach your full potential. We have designed our offices to be inclusive, offering a vibrant environment to cultivate collaboration and connection. Our exceptional culture, repeatedly recognized as a Great Place to Work, ensures that every employee feels valued and empowered to contribute to our collective success.



Don't meet every single requirement? If you're excited about this role and possess the fundamental traits, drive, and strong ambition we seek, but your experience doesn't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply.


*Dialpad is an equal\-opportunity employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment.*

title: Salesforce Developer - Senior
description:
**Why We Stand Out**


Seeking a new challenge where your professional and personal aspirations are not only possible but supported? Kaufman Rossin might be just the place for you!


Kaufman Rossin Professional Services Private Limited’s (the “Company”) offices are located in the World Trade Center (WTC) in Bangalore, Karnataka, India, and at Udyog Vihar, in Gurgaon, Haryana, India.


The Bangalore office provides a range of services, including risk management, corporate governance, tax, assurance, and family office services. Out of the Gurgaon office, we render highly specialized back\-office alternative investment services for global hedge funds and related fund types. As one of the top accounting firms in the US, our foundation is “people first”. In the words of James Kaufman, one of our founders, “We prioritize our people, their development, and their well\-being. Our values are translated into action every day."


Kaufman Rossin, headquartered in Miami, Florida has been celebrated as the Best Place to Work in South Florida more than a dozen times. The firm has grown to over 700 employees, with offices spanning the tri\-county area and sister entities, Kaufman Rossin Wealth and Kaufman Rossin Alternative Investment Services.


The Firm is ranked 49th among the top 100 firms in the US by Inside Public Accounting 2023\. Internationally, the Firm has offices in Bangalore and Haryana in India and the Ivory Coast in Africa.

 **Think you have what it takes?**


Kaufman Rossin is seeking a Senior Salesforce Developer based in Bengaluru to lead the development, architecture, integration, and continuous improvement of the Salesforce platform.


Salesforce serves as the firms core CRM and client engagement platform, supporting pipeline and relationship management, client service processes, internal business operations, client and stakeholder experiences, integrations, automation, analytics, and increasingly AI\-powered capabilities through Agentforce.


This is a senior, hands\-on engineering role with broad platform ownership. You will partner directly with US\-based stakeholders and the Bengaluru PO/BA to define solutions, make architecture decisions, lead and mentor the Junior Salesforce Developer, and ensure Salesforce environment is well\-governed, performant, secure, scalable, and aligned with the firm's growth.


You will bring deep Salesforce platform expertise, strong Apex and LWC engineering skills, modern integration experience, and the platform maturity to balance delivery velocity with long\-term architectural health.


As we expand the use of Salesforce AI, this role will also play an important part in the design, development, governance, testing, and deployment of Agentforce solutions across the firm.

 **Requirements** **How You’ll Contribute:**

**Solution Architecture \& Technical Leadership**

* Own end\-to\-end solution design for Salesforce initiatives — evaluating declarative vs. programmatic approaches, assessing governor limit implications, integration dependencies, security considerations, and long\-term maintainability.
* Lead technical discovery with the Bengaluru PO/BA and US stakeholders — translating complex business requirements into well\-structured, scalable Salesforce solutions before development begins.
* Define and enforce Salesforce development standards across the team — coding conventions, test class quality standards, Flow best practices, naming conventions, API standards, security practices, and metadata organization in source control.
* Review and approve code and configuration changes from the Junior Salesforce Developer — providing structured, actionable feedback that builds their skills over time.
* Lead Salesforce release planning — coordinating sandbox environments, CI/CD deployments, pre\-release testing, regression testing, and production release governance.
* Proactively identify technical debt, platform risks, deprecated functionality, API dependencies, and scaling constraints — producing a prioritized remediation backlog and advocating for appropriate remediation.

**Sales Cloud — Advanced Development**

* Design and build complex Flows, Apex triggers, batch Apex, queueable Apex, scheduled processes, and asynchronous processing — handling sophisticated business process automation while balancing performance and governor limits.
* Build and maintain advanced Lightning Web Components — including components with complex state management, Lightning Data Service, wire adapters, server\-side Apex controllers, and integrations with external systems.
* Design reusable Salesforce services, components, and automation frameworks that reduce technical debt and improve development consistency.
* Lead Sales Cloud data model design — custom object architecture, junction objects, roll\-up strategies, relationship models, and schema decisions that maintain performance and scalability.
* Build solutions using Salesforce security and sharing architecture, including roles, sharing rules, permission sets, permission set groups, restriction rules, and programmatic sharing where appropriate.

**Agentforce \& Salesforce AI**

* Design, configure, test, deploy, and continuously improve Agentforce agents that support business processes and user workflows.
* Partner with business stakeholders to identify high\-value Agentforce use cases and translate them into secure, measurable, and scalable AI solutions.
* Configure Agentforce topics, instructions, actions, and grounding strategies to enable agents to reason and take appropriate actions across Salesforce.
* Build custom Agentforce actions using Flow, Apex, and other Salesforce platform capabilities where out\-of\-the\-box actions do not meet business requirements.
* Develop and manage Prompt Builder templates and reusable AI capabilities that support Agentforce and other Salesforce AI use cases.
* Integrate Agentforce with Salesforce records, Flows, Apex services, APIs, and external systems to enable agents to execute business processes safely.
* Implement appropriate security, permissions, data access, and governance controls for Agentforce to ensure agents operate within authorized boundaries.
* Establish testing and quality\-assurance practices for Agentforce, including evaluation of agent responses, actions, grounding, accuracy, and business outcomes before production deployment.
* Monitor Agentforce usage, performance, adoption, errors, and consumption to continuously improve agent effectiveness and manage platform resources.
* Stay current on Salesforce Agentforce, Prompt Builder, Data 360/Data Cloud, Einstein, and Salesforce AI platform capabilities and advise on opportunities for responsible adoption.

**Service Cloud**

* Own Service Cloud architecture and configuration — designing case management models, queue structures, assignment rules, escalation logic, and SLA frameworks that support client service and internal operations.
* Build and maintain Service Cloud Flows and automation — case routing, status lifecycle management, SLA milestone tracking, notifications, and closure procedures that reduce manual effort and improve resolution time.
* Configure and manage the Service Console — page layouts, quick actions, macros, Lightning components, and productivity features that give service teams the tools to resolve cases efficiently.
* Implement and maintain entitlements, milestones, and SLA policies where appropriate.
* Integrate Service Cloud with external systems and intake channels through supported Salesforce APIs, Email\-to\-Case, Web\-to\-Case, Experience Cloud, and other appropriate integration patterns.
* Build Service Cloud analytics covering case volume, resolution time, SLA compliance, queue health, trends, and operational performance.

**Experience Cloud**

* Own the architecture and development of Experience Cloud sites — designing portal structures, navigation models, page layouts, and digital experiences for client\-facing and internal stakeholder audiences.
* Configure member profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, and guest user policies — ensuring each audience sees the appropriate data, content, and functionality.
* Build custom Experience Cloud components using LWC — delivering dynamic, data\-driven portal experiences that integrate with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Agentforce, Knowledge, and other Salesforce capabilities.
* Implement Experience Cloud integrations with external identity providers — supporting SSO, registration handlers, and authentication flows that meet security and access management standards.
* Design and maintain Knowledge capabilities within Experience Cloud where appropriate.
* Monitor and optimize Experience Cloud site performance, component efficiency, security, and reliability.

**Data Quality \& Governance**

* Own Salesforce data governance framework — defining data ownership, field\-level standards, picklist governance, naming conventions, documentation requirements, and data stewardship processes.
* Design and implement a comprehensive duplicate management strategy — configuring matching rules, duplicate rules, and remediation processes that maintain a clean, trusted CRM dataset at scale.
* Establish and enforce data validation architecture — validation rules, required fields, formula\-based alerts, Flow\-driven data hygiene checks, and automated exception management.
* Lead data migration and enrichment initiatives — designing field mappings, transformation logic, reconciliation procedures, and post\-load validation processes.
* Build data governance dashboards and exception reports — giving leadership visibility into data completeness, stale records, missing critical information, duplicates, and data quality trends.
* Partner with IT security and compliance functions on Salesforce data governance — including field\-level security, data classification, retention, auditability, and appropriate AI data access.
* Ensure Agentforce and other AI capabilities operate against trusted, appropriately governed, and permission\-aware Salesforce data.

**DevOps, Platform Health \& Mentorship**

* Own the Salesforce DevOps pipeline — Salesforce CLI, VS Code, Git\-based source control, and Azure DevOps CI/CD for automated deployment, validation, testing, and release management.
* Maintain a healthy sandbox strategy with clear promotion paths, refresh schedules, testing standards, and hotfix governance.
* Conduct regular platform health reviews — storage consumption, API usage, Flow error rates, Apex job performance, integration logs, deprecated API usage, security configuration, and system performance.
* Maintain Salesforce security posture — permission architecture, least\-privilege access, field\-level security, sharing rules, role hierarchy design, connected apps, and integration\-user security.
* Mentor and coach the Junior Salesforce Developer — pairing on complex problems, conducting structured code reviews, and investing in their growth toward senior\-level capability.
* Produce and maintain comprehensive technical documentation — including data dictionaries, integration architecture diagrams, API inventories, solution designs, deployment runbooks, Agentforce documentation, and release notes.
* Monitor Salesforce product and feature retirements and proactively develop remediation plans to avoid disruption to business\-critical functionality.

**What Skills You’ll Bring:**

**Required**

* 5\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce development experience, with at least 2 years in a senior or lead developer capacity.
* Deep Sales Cloud expertise — complex Flow, Apex triggers, Batch/Queueable Apex, LWC, data modeling, security architecture, and advanced automation.
* Strong Salesforce integration architecture experience using REST APIs, Bulk APIs, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, Named Credentials, OAuth, and other modern integration patterns.
* Demonstrated experience modernizing or maintaining Salesforce integrations as API versions, authentication requirements, and platform capabilities evolve.
* Experience designing secure integrations using OAuth 2\.0, JWT, Named Credentials, External Credentials, connected apps, and least\-privilege integration users.
* Hands\-on experience with Agentforce, including agent configuration, topics, instructions, actions, testing, deployment, and optimization.
* Experience with Prompt Builder and integrating Agentforce with Salesforce automation such as Flow and Apex.
* Understanding of AI security, grounding, permissions, testing, governance, and responsible deployment within Salesforce.
* Service Cloud experience — case management architecture, queue/assignment/escalation design, Service Console, automation, and service operations.
* Experience Cloud experience — portal architecture, member access, LWC components, sharing model design, authentication, and Knowledge integration.
* Salesforce data governance experience — duplicate management, validation architecture, data quality monitoring, migrations, and enrichment.
* Salesforce DevOps experience — Salesforce CLI, VS Code, Git source control, and CI/CD pipeline configuration using Azure DevOps or equivalent.
* Salesforce Platform Developer I certification — mandatory.
* Excellent written and spoken English — able to lead technical discovery sessions, present architecture decisions, mentor developers, and communicate with US\-based IT leadership and business stakeholders with confidence and clarity.

**Preferred**

* Demonstrated production experience implementing and supporting Agentforce agents beyond Trailhead or proof\-of\-concept environments.
* Salesforce Platform Developer II certification.
* Salesforce Certified Application Architect or System Architect.
* Service Cloud Consultant certification.
* Experience Cloud Consultant certification.
* Experience with Data 360/Data Cloud as a grounding or retrieval source for Agentforce.
* Experience with Salesforce Prompt Builder and AI governance.
* Experience designing event\-driven Salesforce architectures using Platform Events and Change Data Capture.
* Salesforce CRM Analytics development experience.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps pipelines and Salesforce DX for automated deployments.
* Experience with integration monitoring, API lifecycle management, and modernization of legacy

**What We Offer:**

* Direct partnership with US\-based stakeholders and Architecture team — your decisions shape how the firm manages client relationships and service delivery at scale.
* A Bengaluru team culture that treats every engineer as a first\-class member of one global team.
* Clear growth path toward Salesforce Architect or Technical Lead as CRM capabilities expand.
* Full support for Salesforce certifications — Application Architect, System Architect, Service Cloud Consultant, Experience Cloud Consultant, and beyond.
* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits commensurate with senior\-level expertise

  

**Benefits**  

* Work\-Life Balance
* People First Company
* Hybrid work policy
* Working directly with peers in the US

Join EarnIn's Developer Experience team for a 12\-week summer internship building agentic AI infrastructure that directly improves how engineers ship software. You'll own meaningful end\-to\-end work on intelligent developer tooling and design systems that turn raw CI signals into actionable insights under the guidance of senior engineers. * Familiarity with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD systems, curiosity about how they work under the hood.
* Some exposure to working with APIs and structured data formats.
* Interest in AI/LLM\-powered tooling; you don't need production experience, but you should be excited to learn how agents and tool\-calling work.

* Ability to work independently in a remote environment, communicate progress proactively, and ask for help when blocked is a plus.
* Prior internship or project experience in developer tooling, platform engineering, or observability is a plus.

description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**
 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
 



 We are looking for an experienced Principal Software Engineer to work on our next\-generation Imports Platform team. Imports Platform team is leading a strategic initiative to modernize Okta's identity lifecycle management capabilities by architecting and migrating from a legacy monolithic system to a highly scalable, distributed microservices platform. This critical service orchestrates the importing, syncing, and provisioning of identities and access policies—users, groups, roles, entitlements—from external directory services including Active Directory, Office 365, and LDAP\-based systems.
 



 As a Principal Software Engineer on the Imports Platform team, you will be a cross\-team technical leader who takes difficult, ambiguously defined problems and drives them from ideation through production impact without oversight. You will own projects from zero to landing—defining scope, planning execution, making architectural decisions, and articulating measurable impact across the group. You will generate novel solutions to complex distributed systems challenges, guide the team's technical direction, and get stakeholder buy\-in on architectural strategy spanning multiple teams.
 



 Your sphere of influence extends beyond the Imports Platform team to adjacent teams within the group and cross\-functional partners in Product, Design, and SRE. You will participate in group\-level strategy, break down strategic initiatives into actionable technical milestones, and drive cross\-team operational excellence. You'll tackle challenges including massive\-scale batch processing, real\-time synchronization, user matching algorithms, and identity resolution serving thousands of enterprise customers.
 



 This role requires exceptional technical depth, strategic thinking, and the ability to independently navigate ambiguity while balancing short\-term delivery with long\-term platform health. You will improve engineering culture, mentor staff and senior engineers, self\-direct cross\-functional collaborations, and help shape the future of Okta's Imports platform and identity lifecycle management capabilities.

 \- Own projects from zero to landing, including ideation, planning, scoping, design, implementation, deployment, and clear articulation of project impact
 



 \- Generate design ideas and expert solutions for ambiguous, cross\-team problems, taking complete ownership from conception through production and customer impact

 \#\#\# Engineering Craft

**Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

 \- Expert\-level knowledge of Spring Boot framework, Maven, and modern Java development practices
