Job Description
Arctic Wolf, with its unicorn valuation, is the leader in security operations in an exciting and fast\-growing industry—cybersecurity. We have won countless awards for our excellence in security operations and remain dedicated to providing an industry\-leading customer and employee experience.


Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a **Senior Developer \- Managed Risk Platform** to be part of making this happen.  

  



**About the Role**  

The Arctic Wolf security operations platform ingests and processes upwards of 250 billion events a day from a wide variety of on\-premise devices and cloud platforms. The security pipeline is a **distributed system** of loosely\-coupled microservices that constitute our **real\-time analysis** and **threat detection systems.** These services distill the incoming events into actionable intelligence that our Concierge Security Teams use to protect customers.
  

We are growing rapidly, with our data volume increasing ten\-fold roughly every two years. We are looking for experienced developers to join our pack and work with us to continuously evolve and expand the capabilities of our security platform. This particular role focuses on building components of our Managed Risk Platform.  

  



**You Will:**

* Create and scale high\-performance services in a real\-time threat analysis pipeline
* Architect, design, develop, test and deliver software in an agile environment
* Deploy containerised services to production within hours after your changes are merged, in keeping with our culture of Continuous Integration and Infrastructure\-as\-Code
* Work as part of a team of highly skilled engineers
* Continuously learn and expand your technical horizons

**Our Technology Stack:**  

**Golang, Docker, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Kubernetes/EKS, PostgresSQL, Kafka, Java, Linux**  



**About You:**

* **Excited to work at the intersection of Big Data and the Cybersecurity problem spaces**
* **5\+ years of experience shipping production\-quality software**
* **Love coding**
* **Experience deploying services on cloud computing platforms (e.g, AWS, Azure, GCP)**
* **Experience with Golang is preferred**
* **Experience with Postgres databases and Kubernetes is preferred**
* **Experience working on distributed systems and microservices architecture is preferred .**

**We are looking for Only Bangalore Based Candidates.**

**About the Company**

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including **Top Workplace USA** (2021\-2024\), **Best Places to Work – USA** (2021\-2024\), **Great Place to Work – Canada** (2021\-2024\), **Great Place to Work – UK** (2024\), and **Kununu Top Company – Germany** (2024\). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 7,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.


**Our Values**

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion, and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance.


All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

description:
**Hello there! We're Infrrd.** 




 Infrrd (pronounced In\-fur\-d) is an Enterprise AI company that uses AI and Machine Learning to automate human tasks in document\-heavy workflows across mortgage, insurance, and finance. We are looking for a Senior Java Developer to help build and own the backend services that power our mortgage document processing platform.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 You will own backend services that process large, complex mortgage documents at scale — designing the pipelines, integrating LLMs, and keeping the whole thing fast, accurate, and cost effective in production. This is a hands\-on senior role with real ownership: you will make architecture calls, drive them to a decision, and set the quality bar for engineers working alongside you.
 



  





**What You'll Actually Work On:** 




 High\-throughput extraction pipelines that process big\-size documents and large volumes of data in parallel, LLM failover and resilience logic across multiple model providers, and continuous work on accuracy, latency, and cost.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 
 :
 


* **Build high\-throughput document pipelines.** 
 Asynchronous, parallel processing with batching, retries, backpressure, and idempotent reprocessing for big\-size documents and large data volumes.
* **Work with the latest LLMs.** 
 Build against current LLM APIs — timeouts, token and cost controls, response validation, and automatic failover between providers.
* **Engineer for resilience.** 
 Circuit breakers, fallback chains, and graceful degradation so a single upstream failure never takes the pipeline down.
* **Debug production.** 
 Investigate extraction failures, latency spikes, and cost regressions using dashboards and metrics, and fix the root cause.
* **Raise the bar on the team.** 
 Review PRs, break features into clear tasks, unblock junior engineers, and write design docs that hold up to scrutiny across time zones.



  





  





**Who You Are** 
 :
 


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 4\+ years of hands\-on Java development, including at least 2 years owning a production service.
* Excellent command of Core Java, with real depth in multithreading and concurrent architecture design.
* Strong with Spring Boot and Spring Data; comfortable in microservices and REST architecture.
* Strong working knowledge of No\-SQL DB (preferred MongoDB ); familiar with relational databases (MySQL or PostgreSQL).
* Comfortable with Docker and Kubernetes, and at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills with a solid command of data structures.
* Reasons about tradeoffs — cost, latency, and accuracy — not just correctness.
* Has informally mentored or guided junior engineers; the person others come to when they're stuck.
* Operates independently with minimal supervision, and proactively flags risks instead of waiting to be asked.
* Excellent written communication — much of the collaboration is asynchronous and across time zones.



  





**Good to Have** 
 :
 


* Exposure to LLM or GenAI application development — prompt iteration, evaluation, or accuracy measurement.
* Working knowledge of Python.
* Experience with streaming queues like Kafka or RabbitMQ.
* Background in Document AI, OCR, or the mortgage / fintech domain.
* Familiarity with observability tooling (Grafana, Metabase, ELK).



  





**Work Mode:** 




 5\-days work in office with flexible working hours (Google Maps Location).
 



  





**Curious about the kind of engineering challenges we solve? Check out a few of our tech talks:** 




**Automated Data Extraction from Engineering \& Construction Drawings** 




**Ally \| Agentic AI for Mortgage** 




**NLP\-powered Table Extraction for Insurance Policy Data**

We’re looking for a **Shopify Developer who also has a strong eye for UI/UX and eCommerce design.**

Someone who can build a technically solid Shopify store, but also understands that a good eCommerce website is not just about clean code.

It needs to **look good, feel intuitive and convert.**

At WebzPlot, we work with brands across fashion, jewellery, beauty, lifestyle, D2C and other eCommerce categories. We’re looking for someone who can take a store from idea to execution while thinking about both the customer experience and the development behind it.

What You’ll Do

* Build and customise Shopify stores from scratch
* Work with Shopify 2\.0 themes and custom sections
* Develop using Liquid, HTML, CSS and JavaScript
* Customise existing themes based on client requirements
* Convert Figma or design concepts into responsive Shopify pages
* Design and improve product pages, collection pages, landing pages and homepages
* Create clean, modern and conversion\-focused eCommerce layouts
* Improve mobile shopping experiences
* Work on cart, upsell, cross\-sell and conversion\-focused functionality
* Integrate Shopify apps and third\-party tools
* Troubleshoot theme, app and frontend issues
* Improve website speed and frontend performance
* Maintain consistent design systems across the store

The UI/UX Side Matters

We are not looking for someone who simply takes a design and codes it.

We want someone who can look at an eCommerce page and understand:

* Whether the visual hierarchy makes sense
* Whether the CTA is prominent enough
* Whether the product information is easy to scan
* Whether the page feels trustworthy
* Whether the mobile experience is smooth
* Whether too many elements are creating friction
* Whether the layout supports conversion

You should be able to suggest improvements instead of blindly implementing everything you are given.

What We Expect From You

You should have strong working knowledge of:

* Shopify
* Shopify Liquid
* HTML
* CSS
* JavaScript
* Shopify 2\.0 architecture
* Metafields and dynamic content
* Theme customisation
* Responsive design
* Cross\-browser compatibility
* Shopify app integrations
* Basic performance optimisation

You should also have a strong understanding of:

* eCommerce UI/UX
* Conversion\-focused design
* Product page structure
* Collection page usability
* Mobile\-first design
* Visual hierarchy
* Typography and spacing
* CTA placement
* Navigation and information architecture

Design Tools

Experience with the following is preferred:

* Figma
* Adobe Photoshop
* Adobe Illustrator
* Canva

Figma knowledge is especially important.

You do not need to be a full\-time graphic designer, but you should be comfortable creating and refining clean website layouts.

You’ll Be a Strong Fit If

You care about the small details.

You notice when spacing is inconsistent.

You understand why a button should be above the fold.

You know when a page looks visually impressive but is difficult to shop.

You think about the customer journey before adding another section.

You can balance aesthetics with conversion.

And when you build something, you test it properly across desktop and mobile instead of assuming it works.

Bonus Points If You

* Have experience working with D2C brands
* Have built premium or luxury eCommerce websites
* Understand CRO
* Know basic SEO principles for Shopify
* Have experience with page builders
* Understand Shopify app conflicts
* Can work with APIs or custom integrations
* Have experience with Git
* Understand accessibility and usability best practices
* Can create reusable Shopify sections that clients can manage easily

What Your Work Will Be Judged On

Not just whether the website works.

We’ll look at:

* Code quality
* Visual quality
* Responsiveness
* Website speed
* User experience
* Conversion thinking
* Attention to detail
* Ability to solve problems independently

Experience

**2 to 5 years preferred**

Strong Shopify experience is required.

Agency experience is an advantage because you’ll be working across multiple brands and projects.

Location

**Bangalore \- In our JP Nagar Office**

Think You’re a Fit?

Send us:

* Your CV
* Your Shopify portfolio
* 3 websites you have worked on
* What you specifically handled on each project

* Flexible schedule

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.



This Position reports to:



Digital Solution Engineering Manager \#\#\#


### **What we believe in**



ABB's Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world's largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner.



We offer a broad range of automation, electrification, and digital solutions for process, hybrid, and maritime industries, including industry\-specific integrated control systems, software, measurement, analytics, and lifecycle services. Our digital portfolio enables customers to improve operational excellence, reliability, sustainability, and digital transformation across industrial operations.


### **Your role and responsibilities**



In this role, you will join ABB's Industrial Automation Digital Organization as a Senior Software Engineer – AI Platforms \& Applications. You will contribute to the development of next\-generation AI\-enabled applications, cloud\-native platforms, and intelligent automation solutions that power ABB's Industrial AI and Copilot ecosystem. Working closely with Architects, AI/ML Engineers, Product Management, Platform Engineering, and DevOps teams, you will design, develop, and deploy scalable software solutions that integrate AI capabilities, MLOps workflows, and modern cloud technologies to deliver innovative industrial digital products.



This role is contributing to the Digital Industry Analytics / Research \& Development organization in Bangalore, India.



The work model for the role is: Hybrid



\#\#


### **You will be mainly accountable for:**


* Design, develop, and maintain scalable AI\-enabled applications, backend services, APIs, and cloud\-native microservices using modern software engineering practices to deliver secure and high\-performing enterprise solutions.
* Develop and integrate AI/ML capabilities, MLOps pipelines, AutoML workflows, and intelligent automation services while supporting model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management across cloud platforms.
* Collaborate with Architects, AI/ML Engineers, Product Management, DevOps, and Quality Engineering teams to deliver end\-to\-end software solutions, drive technical excellence, and ensure successful product releases.
* Contribute across the complete software development lifecycle by implementing responsive user interfaces, optimizing application performance, ensuring software quality, and driving continuous improvements through Agile and DevOps practices.

### **Qualifications for the role**


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* 6–10 years of experience in software engineering with strong expertise in developing enterprise\-grade, cloud\-native applications using Python and modern software development practices.
* Strong experience in frontend development using Angular, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, along with backend development using REST APIs, microservices, and distributed application architectures.
* Hands\-on experience with Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning integration, MLOps practices, Azure Machine Learning, AutoML workflows, and model lifecycle management.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and cloud\-native deployment models.
* Good understanding of observability, monitoring, logging, telemetry, cybersecurity best practices, and secure software development for enterprise applications.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills with experience working in Agile, cross\-functional, and globally distributed engineering teams.

### **More about us**



ABB is a global technology leader in electrification and automation, helping industries become more productive, efficient, and sustainable. The Process Automation business automates, electrifies, and digitalizes some of the world's most complex industrial infrastructures, serving customers across energy, process, hybrid, marine, mining, chemicals, water, and manufacturing industries.



The Digital Industry Analytics organization is driving ABB's next generation of Industrial AI, intelligent automation, and cloud\-native software platforms by combining advanced analytics, machine learning, and domain expertise. At ABB, we foster an inclusive culture where collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning empower our people to create sustainable digital solutions that accelerate industrial transformation worldwide.



Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.



Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Steinberg and John Sculley, former CEO of Apple Inc and Pepsi\-Cola, the Company combines the industry’s 3rd largest proprietary data set (2\.4B\+ identities) with Artificial Intelligence to unlock consumer intent, personalize experiences and help our clients drive business growth.

At the center of its innovation is the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), which unifies customer data, identity, and advanced analytics to transform billions of data signals into actionable marketing intelligence and measurable business outcomes.  

  

Publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: ZETA), Zeta is redefining modern marketing with Athena by Zeta™, a superintelligent, conversational agent embedded in ZMP that personalizes the marketer’s workspace, surfaces platform generated insights through natural dialogue and recommends next\-best actions to help brands accelerate and optimize their marketing outcomes.

title: Principal Software Engineer- Performance Engineering
description:
**Principal Software Engineer, Performance Engineering**

Job Summary


We are seeking a Principal Software Engineer, Performance Engineering to embed performance as a first\-class engineering discipline across our large\-scale applications and databases — shifting performance validation left into design and active development, rather than treating it as a pre\-release regression gate. This is a hybrid engineering role: the candidate writes and reviews code, builds performance tooling and instrumentation, and partners directly with feature teams during design and implementation to catch scalability and efficiency issues before they reach production. The ideal candidate is fluent in Linux environments, comfortable authoring both application\-level code and test/automation code, skilled in modern load and performance testing frameworks integrated into CI/CD, and capable of deep database performance analysis to identify and resolve bottlenecks at the query, index, and schema level. This role requires a minimum of 10 years of relevant software engineering experience.


Why This Role Is Different


Traditional performance testing runs *after* code is "done," turning every finding into a costly late\-cycle fix. This role exists to move that curve left: performance budgets, load profiles, and profiling hooks become part of design review, code review, and CI — not a separate phase owned by a separate team.


Key Responsibilities


Shift\-Left Performance Engineering


* Partner with Product Architects and engineering teams *during design and development* to define performance/scalability requirements, SLOs, and load profiles before code is written.
* Embed lightweight, code\-as\-test performance checks (e.g., k6, Gatling, Locust) directly into CI/CD pipelines so regressions surface on every build/PR, not at a downstream test cycle.
* Review production code and architecture for performance anti\-patterns (N\+1 queries, unbounded loops, inefficient serialization, poor connection/thread pool sizing) as part of the normal code review process.
* Build and maintain reusable performance test harnesses, fixtures, and synthetic data generators that developers can run locally and in CI without specialist hand\-holding.

Load, Stress, and Full\-Scale Validation


* Design, script, execute, and evaluate performance, load, and stress tests to validate system behavior under expected and peak conditions, using modern load\-generation tooling (k6, Gatling, Locust) alongside JMeter/LoadRunner for legacy scenario coverage.
* Develop and maintain scripts to simulate realistic UI and transactional load across applications.
* Use the Linux command line and shell/Python scripting to configure environments, automate test setup/execution/data collection/reporting, and troubleshoot in flight.

Database \& Query Performance


* Write and evaluate SQL queries against large\-scale databases to support test data preparation and results analysis.
* Perform detailed evaluation of table and index design, query execution plans, and their impact on overall database performance.
* Generate and analyze deep diagnostics (Oracle AWR/ASH, SQL Server Query Store/MDW, or Postgres pg\_profile/PoWA) to isolate database\-layer bottlenecks.
* Generate and load large volumes of representative test data to support realistic performance validation.

Analysis, Instrumentation \& Remediation


* Analyze test and production telemetry (APM, profiling, GC/memory data) to identify root causes and drive optimization — collaborating directly with developers, DBAs, and infrastructure teams on fixes, not just findings.
* Evaluate and tune JVM memory management and garbage collection behavior under load.
* Document performance requirements, findings, and recommendations, and communicate clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

Required Skills and Experience


* Minimum 10 years of software engineering experience, including a minimum of 6 years focused on performance engineering, performance/load testing, or a closely related discipline.
* Demonstrated ability to write and/or review production application code — this is not a testing\-only role.
* Strong proficiency with the Linux command line for navigation, file management, process monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Semi\-advanced scripting ability (Bash/Korn, Python, or Perl) to automate workflows and build reusable tooling.
* Hands\-on experience with JMeter and/or LoadRunner for legacy load scenario coverage.
* Hands\-on experience integrating performance/load tests into CI/CD pipelines (shift\-left practice), using modern frameworks such as k6, Gatling, or Locust.
* Experience with Java memory management, garbage collection, evaluation, and tuning.
* Solid understanding of large\-scale database fundamentals: SQL, table/index design, referential integrity, and query performance evaluation.
* Hands\-on experience with Oracle AWR/ASH generation and evaluation, or equivalent (SQL Server Query Store/MDW, Postgres pg\_profile/PoWA).
* Ability to work with Product Management, Architects, and engineering teams to define performance requirements early in the development lifecycle, and to prioritize competing demands accordingly.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, Tanzu, or OpenShift for deploying, scaling, and monitoring workloads under test.
* Familiarity with Cassandra or Scylla; performance evaluation and tuning experience in either is a plus.

Preferred (Nice to Have) Skills


* Experience extending JMeter/LoadRunner or custom Java\-based test frameworks for runtime transaction generation.
* Experience with APM/observability platforms (Dynatrace, New Relic, Datadog, Grafana) for production\-signal\-driven performance work.
* Python for data analysis and tooling beyond test automation.
* Basic project management and Agile Scrum experience.

What We Offer


* Ownership of performance as an engineering discipline, not a downstream checkpoint — direct influence on architecture and design decisions.
* Exposure to large\-scale, high\-throughput fintech systems and modern cloud\-native infrastructure.
* Collaborative engineering culture with direct partnership across product, architecture, and infrastructure teams.
Competitive compensation and benefits package.

title: Senior Software Engineer - (Java & DSA)
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  

  

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.  

  

This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

### **Company Description**



Okta is the leading independent provider of enterprise identity. The Okta Identity Cloud enables organizations to securely connect the right people to the right technologies at the right time. With over 6,500 pre\-built integrations to applications and infrastructure providers, Okta customers can easily and securely use the best technologies for their business. Over 7,950 organizations, including 20th Century Fox, JetBlue, Nordstrom, Slack, Teach for America, and Twilio, trust Okta to help protect the identities of their workforces and customers.


### **Position Description**



We are seeking an experienced **Senior Software Engineer** to play a key role in building and scaling the **Okta Recovery Vault (ORV)**. This team is responsible for Okta's enterprise\-grade soft\-delete and object recovery capability, designed to protect critical identity objects (Users and Groups) from accidental or malicious deletion.



As a Senior Engineer, you will own the technical design, implementation, and operational reliability of critical components within our real\-time, high\-fidelity recovery system. You will solve complex engineering problems around identity preservation (UUIDs) and relationship restoration—including group memberships, app assignments, and password hashes—ensuring our customers can seamlessly recover from data loss events.


### **Job Duties and Responsibilities**


* **Feature Execution:** Drive the technical design and end\-to\-end implementation of complex features, such as granular and bulk recovery workflows across Free and Advanced Resilience tiers.
* **Component Design:** Design and build reliable core components for real\-time recovery systems that capture deletion events and support scalable data restoration.
* **Relationship \& State Management:** Solve challenging engineering problems around relationship restoration (group memberships, app assignments, device enrollments) and state consistency.
* **Security \& Compliance:** Implement secure logging and tracking for all recovery operations (soft\-delete, restore, permanent\-delete) in Syslog to adhere to strict audit and compliance standards.
* **Product \& Cross\-Functional Alignment:** Partner with Product Managers and technical leads to clarify requirements, define technical scope, and break down complex projects into actionable milestones.
* **Operational Excellence:** Participate in on\-call rotations, troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis (RCAs), and enhance system observability, logging, and metrics.
* **Code Quality \& Technical Standards:** Champion engineering best practices through thorough code reviews, automated testing, and comprehensive technical documentation.
* **Team Growth:** Provide guidance and peer mentorship to intermediate and junior engineers on the team to foster technical growth and code quality.

### **Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**


* **Experience:** 5\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience building and scaling highly reliable, production\-grade applications.
* **Java Expertise:** Strong proficiency in object\-oriented programming, with extensive experience in **Java** and the **Spring Boot** framework.
* **Distributed Systems:** Solid experience with distributed system patterns, asynchronous job processing, and event\-driven architectures (essential for bulk restore operations).

title: Senior Quality Engineer, Automation & API Testing
description:
LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open\-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open\-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.


LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 65 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.


OUR PEOPLE:


People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.


We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.


**Position Overview**

  

The Senior Quality Engineer is responsible for driving quality across the software development lifecycle through a strong focus on test automation, API validation, quality engineering practices, and continuous delivery. This role partners closely with Engineering, Product, Architecture, and DevOps teams to establish testing strategies, improve automation coverage, identify quality risks early, and enable rapid, reliable releases.


The Senior QE serves as a quality advocate and technical leader, helping teams adopt scalable automation frameworks, shift\-left testing practices, and data\-driven quality standards. The role is expected to operate independently, influence engineering decisions, and mentor team members on quality engineering best practices.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Quality Strategy \& Test Leadership**

* Define and execute comprehensive quality strategies aligned with product and engineering objectives.
* Lead test planning activities and establish risk\-based testing approaches across initiatives.
* Review requirements, architectures, and designs to identify quality risks and testability concerns early.
* Establish quality gates, standards, and automation objectives for development teams.
* Provide technical leadership on quality engineering practices across multiple products or services.
* Mentor Quality Engineers and development teams on automation, testing methodologies, and quality best practices.

**API \& Service\-Level Testing**

* Design, develop, and maintain robust API and service\-level automation frameworks.
* Validate REST, GraphQL, and microservice\-based architectures through automated testing.
* Create automated tests covering functional, integration, contract, regression, and negative testing scenarios.
* Validate authentication, authorization, data integrity, error handling, and security controls across services.
* Perform data validation through API responses, databases, queues, and downstream integrations.
* Collaborate with developers to improve API testability and observability.

**Test Automation Engineering**

* Design and maintain scalable automation frameworks for UI, API, integration, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Develop reusable automation libraries, utilities, and test data management solutions.
* Drive automation\-first testing approaches, minimizing reliance on manual regression testing.
* Continuously improve automation reliability, execution speed, and maintainability.
* Measure automation effectiveness using coverage, execution, defect detection, and quality metrics.
* Ensure automated tests are integrated into CI/CD pipelines and support continuous delivery goals.

**System Integration \& End\-to\-End Testing**

* Validate complex workflows across distributed systems, microservices, and third\-party integrations.
* Design test strategies for highly integrated cloud\-based applications.
* Conduct integration and system testing to ensure end\-to\-end business process validation.
* Identify risks associated with cross\-system dependencies and recommend mitigation strategies.

**Performance, Reliability \& Security Testing**

* Define and execute performance, scalability, and reliability testing approaches.
* Analyze application behaviour under load and identify performance bottlenecks.
* Support security testing initiatives by validating authentication, authorization, and API security controls.
* Collaborate with Engineering teams to improve application resilience and production readiness.

**DevOps \& Continuous Quality**

* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar platforms.
* Ensure quality gates are embedded within deployment pipelines.
* Leverage test execution analytics and quality metrics to drive continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with DevOps teams to improve environment stability, test data availability, and deployment validation.
* Support quality practices within cloud\-native and containerized environments.

**Release Quality \& Production Support**

* Evaluate release readiness using risk assessments, automation results, and quality metrics.
* Participate in production incident investigations and root cause analysis.
* Develop monitoring and validation strategies to ensure quality after deployment.
* Analyze defect trends and recommend preventative quality improvements.

**Skills \& Qualifications**

**Required**

* **7\+ years of experience** in Quality Engineering, Software Testing, or Test Automation.
* Strong experience designing and implementing **test automation frameworks** .
* Advanced experience in **API testing and automation** using tools such as Postman, Rest Assured, Playwright, Karate, or similar frameworks.
* Strong programming/scripting experience with languages such as **Java, C\#, TypeScript, JavaScript, or Python** .
* Experience testing **distributed systems, microservices, and cloud\-native applications** .
* Strong understanding of software architecture, SDLC, Agile, and DevOps methodologies.
* Hands\-on experience with **CI/CD pipelines** and automated quality gates.
* Experience with SQL and database validation techniques.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root\-cause analysis skills.
* Ability to independently drive quality initiatives and influence engineering teams.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud environments.
* Experience with containerized platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience implementing contract testing and service virtualization.
* Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or k6\.
* Experience with observability and monitoring platforms (Application Insights, Datadog, Splunk, Grafana).
* Experience in regulated, enterprise, or high\-availability environments.
* ISTQB Advanced, CSTE, or equivalent certification.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Devices - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**
### **About JumpCloud®**


JumpCloud® is the AI\-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

### **JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

  


As we continue to grow JumpCloud internationally, we are hiring software engineers to expand our product. You’ll have the opportunity to play a key role in the success and development of our engineering teams in addition to growing your own career.

  


**About the Role:**

In this role, you will specifically work on the Device Management (MDM / Endpoint Management) vertical at JumpCloud, the role shifts focus from broad cloud microservices to deeply understanding operating system internals (macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android) and how they communicate with the cloud.



In the Device Management vertical, you will build the software that allows IT administrators to remotely configure, patch, secure, and monitor thousands of endpoints from a single pane of glass. You will work on cross\-OS device management engines, mobile device management / Declarative Device Management(MDM/DDM) telemetry, custom system agents, and zero\-touch enrollment pipelines. This role balances local client\-side programming (interacting with the OS) and building high\-availability cloud APIs.

  


### **What you’ll be doing:**

* Primarily working with Go and Node.js for cross\-platform applications on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
* Gaining or utilizing expertise in areas like Windows services, kernels, Event Loggers, Mac Launch daemons, and macOS internals.
* Collaborating with architects, UX designers, and DevOps to ensure our systems are highly available, scalable, and deliver exceptional user experiences.
* Working within a Scrum framework to drive agile development.
* Learning and working with mTLS protocols and related security concepts. Prior experience in these areas is a plus.
* Using OAuth/OIDC flows for secure user authentication and service access.
* Writing Unit test cases, Functional test cases, acceptance tests along with automating these test cases.
* Contributing to the future of our Device Management services by participating in strategic planning and scoping sessions with product managers.
* Embodying our core values: building strong connections, thinking big, and striving to improve by 1% every day.

### **We’re looking for:**

* 7\-10 years experience developing MAC, Windows, or Linux applications (including integration with third\-party applications) in any modern language (Python, Java) or Golang. Experience in one of them is a must.
* Experience using one of the public cloud providers (AWS, GCP or Azure) with CI/CD pipelines (preferably Github Action) to build, test and deploy. Knowledge of containerization technologies and orchestration with Kubernetes.
* Strong hands\-on experience in backend software or full stack development is a must
* Working knowledge of Swift, C Sharp, C\+\+ would be an added advantage
* Working knowledge on device MDM would be an added advantage
* Willingness to mentor junior members of the team.
* Bonus points if you have experience with Services, event logger, Kernel in Windows OS and/or Launch demon, app hosting in Mac

**Where you’ll be working/Location:**
JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

**You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.**

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on\-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.

**Language:**JumpCloud has teams in 15\+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

**Why JumpCloud?**
If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS\-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission.
